pages: Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, writes a row of small figures with one pencil in a squared exercise book held flat on her knee. Middle distance: the trough, a coiled hose. Background: the tank on the rise, bright morning light.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, leans on the pump pad watching the polished plunger rod rise and fall inside one cast iron cylinder under its guard. Middle distance: a green power head, a spanner. Background: the stock trough, flat daylight.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, stands at the concrete trough with the book shut under one arm, head turned to the pump. Middle distance: the pump pad, the delivery pipe. Background: one green galvanised water tank on the rise, high summer sun.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, crouches at the end of the delivery pipe with one hand on the steel, watching the water come out in spurts. Middle distance: the trough, wet concrete. Background: the pump pad, hard midday light.

Ruka, a stocky Maori man of fifty in a dusty green work coat, comes in from the paddock and sets one manila folder down on the kitchen table, one hand still flat on the cover. Middle distance: a kettle, a stub of pencil. Background: the kitchen window, flat afternoon light.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, stands at the kitchen table with one open squared exercise book under her hand, looking across it. Middle distance: the manila folder, a kitchen chair. Background: the kitchen window, low evening light.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, crouches at the trough overflow with one two hundred litre drum under the hose, counting, one finger raised. Middle distance: the pipe, wet concrete. Background: the pump pad, bright morning light.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, kneels at the open casing with one hand on the yellow steel tape going down the hole, the other on its case. Middle distance: a spanner, a rag. Background: the pump pad, flat daylight.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, stands over the casing and looks down one round steel flange as dark bore water climbs back inside it. Middle distance: the unscrewed cap, a bucket. Background: the pump pad, midday light.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, sits at the kitchen table at night with the tape round her neck and one hand flat on the closed folder. Middle distance: a lamp, a mug. Background: one dark window, lamplight.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, stands at the pump head, both hands on one long polished plunger rod as it comes clear of the cylinder, steam rising. Middle distance: spanners, a rust shower. Background: the shed and trough, low winter light.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, presses her thumb into one soft laced leather cup on the end of the plunger, which lies across an old wool bale. Middle distance: brass rivets, a knife. Background: the pump shed wall, grey daylight.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, stands at the crane jib with one hand on the chain sling over the open casing, looking straight down the hole. Middle distance: the bent hook, a rope. Background: the tank on the rise, hard sunlight.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, kneels on the wet pad holding up one round cast iron foot valve in a wire net, water sheeting off it. Middle distance: the cylinder mouth, a bucket. Background: the pump head, bright daylight.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, holds the foot valve close in both hands, one thumb under a leather flap curled up hard, standing off its seat. Middle distance: a grey crust, a rag. Background: the pump shed, flat daylight.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, presses the curled flap down onto one round brass valve seat and watches one corner lift and let the water past. Middle distance: a probe, an oily rag. Background: the pump shed, grey daylight.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, holds the end of the pipe at the trough, watching one pinhead white air bubble swell and break in the spurting water. Middle distance: the drum, wet concrete. Background: the pump pad, hard afternoon light.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, sits at the bench driving one borrowed pair of leatherworking punches down through a round of wet cup leather. Middle distance: a roll of offcuts, a mallet. Background: the open shed door, low winter light.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, lays one round leather disc flat on the brass seat plate in her palm and holds it up to the light. Middle distance: a second disc, the punches. Background: the pump shed, grey daylight.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, kneels at the pipe with one two hundred litre drum under the spout, the shut pump beside her. Middle distance: the power head, the open cylinder. Background: the tank on the rise, clear morning light.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, watches one concrete stock trough running over, clear water spilling across the concrete into the grass. Middle distance: the full drum, a pencil on the pad. Background: the tank up on the rise, low sun.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, underlines the last line of one open squared exercise book with a pencil, head bent over it. Middle distance: a mug, a plate. Background: the kitchen window, low evening light.

Anika, a Maori girl of thirteen, long black hair in two plaits, a denim-blue work jacket over a grey t-shirt, sleeves pushed up, stands with the shut book pressed flat under her palm, looking across at one green galvanised water tank standing full to its line. Middle distance: the trough spilling clear, wet grass. Background: the ridge, evening light.
